integrity: The published integral and integration-by-parts reduction are attributed to prior work. The asserted additional result is the complete parameter-uniform positivity proof using a strict reflected-kernel inequality. The finite checker is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns limiting expected gap densities and their physical indices only. It does not establish samplewise, finite-segment, or nonphysical-index monotonicity. Independent priority validation has not been performed.
title: Strict molecule-weighted gap monotonicity for every discrete adsorption length
